kind: rendering of a private study twin; pixels only, no geometry file is published
subject: a turbocharger in the owner's possession, named K33 BorgWarner by the owner and in the scan file name; no vehicle application is claimed

scan.instrument: Einstar Vega, operated by the owner
scan.accuracy: not measured: 0.25 mm is the scanner's point spacing, not its accuracy, and no reference length was scanned
scan.licence: the owner's own scan of a part in the owner's possession
scan.why_not_published: AGENTS.md: raw scans are never committed

model.what: study twin rebuilt from the scan: a revolved centre housing, two scrolls and two ducts lofted from superellipse sections fitted to the scan, the turbine inlet flange and outlet boss; union by manifold3d
model.not_modelled: bolts, clamp plates, oil fittings, the wheels (their hub noses are kept), both scroll tongues, passages beyond the scanned depth

deviation.method: 1.5 million area-weighted samples on the scan; unsigned distance to the model surface (libigl), sign from the model's winding number; a sample is exterior when the scan's winding number 1 mm out along its normal is below 0.25
deviation.known_causes: the centre housing sits 1 to 2 mm off the fitted shaft axis, so a revolve about that axis cannot follow it; the turbine scroll sections overfill its flanks; unmodelled features read as red

figure.view_choice: one camera for all three panels; this side avoids the cast markings on the turbine housing underside

colours.right panel grey: scan within 0.5 mm of the model
colours.right panel blue: model proud of the scan (too big), scale clamped at 2 mm
colours.right panel red: model short of the scan (too small) or a feature left out, scale clamped at 2 mm

claims_not_made: not dimensionally inspected, not fitted, not a print file, not a released part
publication_terms: published by the owner's decision of 2026-11-19
